---

## Brand Purpose & Mission
Jegatheesh Web Studio was founded with a single mission: to empower photographers and visual creators to own their digital assets. While platforms like Instagram and Facebook are useful for micro-content, they suffer from algorithm volatility, heavy image compression, and limited lead conversion mechanisms. Jegatheesh Web Studio builds custom-coded, ultra-fast websites that showcase high-resolution photography without speed degradation and provide high-converting lead generation channels (WhatsApp booking, structured inquiry forms, calendar scheduling).

---

## Core Service Catalog

### 1. Photographer Portfolio Website Design
- **Description:** Tailored portfolio websites engineered specifically for wedding, commercial, portrait, fashion, and landscape photographers.
- **Key Features:**
  - Zero image degradation galleries with responsive lazy-loading.
  - Lightbox inspection and category filtering.
  - Mobile-first UI optimized for touch screens and mobile browsers.
  - Frictionless WhatsApp & direct contact buttons.

### 2. Photography Studio Lead Generation Websites
- **Description:** Complete commercial studio websites with service pages, pricing package breakdowns, client testimonials, and Google Local SEO readiness.
- **Key Features:**
  - High-converting landing page structure.
  - Integrated inquiry forms with direct email routing.
  - Rich Schema.org structured data (LocalBusiness, Organization, FAQPage) for Google rich results.

### 3. Bespoke Front-End & Creative Animation Development
- **Description:** High-end motion graphics and interactive web experiences for visual brands.
- **Tech Stack:** Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ JavaScript, GSAP (ScrollTrigger), Three.js, Anime.js, DevIcons.
